references.name: service-spillway-aerial
references.use: Ordinary visual reference only;not a redistributed model texture.
references.observed: Ordinary aerial inspected:long bent rock-fill barrier and crest road,principal five-gate service spillway with deep divided upper chutes and lower common channel,western powerhouse/tailrace/intake structures and a separate smaller outlet. Two-sided embankment,downstream roads/substation and independent properties remain clear. Lettering,logos,construction vehicles and flowing whitewater are not model textures or geometry. Exact machinery,grades and ownership of the adjacent native intake/control footprints still need one geometry-pass decision.
